name: Logfire Observability
description: Pydantic Logfire integration for OpenClaw — distributed tracing, GenAI metrics, and trace links

token.description: Logfire write token. Falls back to LOGFIRE_TOKEN env var.

projectUrl.description: Logfire project URL for trace link generation (e.g. https://logfire.pydantic.dev/myorg/myproject).

environment.description: Deployment environment (e.g. development, production). Falls back to LOGFIRE_ENVIRONMENT env var.

serviceName.description: OTEL service.name resource attribute. Defaults to 'openclaw-agent'.

providerName.description: gen_ai.provider.name attribute (e.g. anthropic, openai). Auto-detected if possible.

captureToolInput.description: Record tool call arguments as gen_ai.tool.call.arguments. Defaults to true.

captureToolOutput.description: Record tool call results as gen_ai.tool.call.result. Defaults to false (can be verbose).

toolInputMaxLength.description: Max characters for tool input capture. Defaults to 2048.

toolOutputMaxLength.description: Max characters for tool output capture. Defaults to 512.

captureStackTraces.description: Attach full stack traces on tool errors. Defaults to true.

captureMessageContent.description: Record gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. Defaults to false (privacy-sensitive).

captureInferenceEvents.description: Emit gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details events. Defaults to false.

redactSecrets.description: Strip values matching common secret patterns from tool args. Defaults to true.

enabled.description: Enable W3C traceparent inject/extract. Defaults to false.

injectIntoCommands.description: Inject traceparent into exec/Bash tool HTTP calls. Defaults to true.

extractFromWebhooks.description: Extract traceparent from inbound webhook headers. Defaults to true.

urlPatterns.description: Glob patterns for URLs that receive traceparent injection. Defaults to ['*'].

enableMetrics.description: Export GenAI token usage and operation duration metrics. Defaults to true.

metricsIntervalMs.description: Metric export interval in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

enableTraceLinks.description: Log clickable Logfire trace URLs after each request. Defaults to true.

spanProcessorType.description: Span processor type. Use 'simple' for debugging. Defaults to 'batch'.

token.label: Logfire Token
token.placeholder: Set LOGFIRE_TOKEN env var or enter here
